title: Verification-log enforcement in CI (no publish without provenance + method + distinct reviewer)
context: The no-self-approval and no-AI-certification rules are safety invariants: a food-assistance entry must not be published as authoritative unless a human reviewer (distinct from the ingester) has confirmed the verification, and AI sessions may not self-certify human-required methods (phone-confirmed, operator-confirmed, partner-confirmed). CI enforcement makes these rules machine-checkable. Depends on food-maps-fresh-009 (the staleness/state layer) and food-maps-ci-005 (the base CI pipeline).
objective: Add CI gates that enforce the verification-log contract: (1) block publication of any entry lacking a complete verification record (sources[], verification_method, verified_by, last_verified); (2) block entries where the approving reviewer equals the ingesting contributor (no self-approval); (3) assert that human-required verification methods (phone-confirmed, operator-confirmed, partner-confirmed) cannot be set by an automated pipeline step (must have a non-automated verified_by); (4) enforce that every published entry has a corresponding PR-tied verification-log entry in docs/verification-log.md.
acceptanceCriteria: CI blocks publication of any entry missing sources[], verification_method, verified_by, or last_verified
CI blocks any PR where the PR author matches the verified_by attribution on entries being added or updated (no self-approval check)

CI asserts that entries with verification_method of phone-confirmed, operator-confirmed, or partner-confirmed have a verified_by that is not an automated identifier (e.g. 'CI', 'pipeline', 'automated')
CI enforces that every newly added or updated entry in data/ has a corresponding entry in docs/verification-log.md referencing the PR number and commit SHA
Verification-log format is documented and validated in CI (schema or structure check)
Unit tests cover: an entry with complete provenance and a distinct reviewer passes; an entry missing verified_by fails; a self-approved entry fails; a pipeline-set phone-confirmed method fails
CI gate produces a clear, actionable error message explaining which entries failed and why
output: src/ci/verify-gate.ts + updated .github/workflows/ci.yml with the verification-log enforcement gate, passing on the pilot dataset.
